title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirect
description: This feature matters as it ensures users are always accessing the application securely, redirecting HTTP requests to HTTPS automatically. It enhances security and improves user trust. The implementation involves configuring the framework to listen for HTTP requests and redirect them to their HTTPS counterparts
testCases: Test HTTP request redirect to HTTPS

acceptance: The feature is accepted when all HTTP requests are successfully redirected to their HTTPS equivalents without errors, and the application remains functional
reason: Enhancing security and following best practices for web development
